scenes.subtitle: Meet Adult IQ Test: 32 questions, 25 minutes, instant results

lines.say: Have you ever wondered how sharp your mind really is?
Meet Adult IQ Test, a free app that challenges your reasoning in just twenty-five minutes.
lines.tts: Meet Adult I Q Test, a free app that challenges your reasoning in just twenty-five minutes.

lines.say: And the moment you finish, it shows you exactly where you stand.

cards.title: Numerical
cards.text: Number sequences and quick math traps

lines.say: The test has thirty-two questions, covering four ways of thinking.
Numerical reasoning, with sequences and sneaky math traps.
Verbal reasoning, with analogies and vocabulary.
Logical reasoning, where you follow the clues to the only possible answer.
And pattern and spatial reasoning, where you turn shapes around in your head.

left.title: The question
left.body:
A bat and a ball cost **$1.10** in total.
The bat costs **$1.00 more** than the ball.

How much does the ball cost?

lines.say: Let's warm up with a real question from the test.
A bat and a ball cost one dollar ten in total. The bat costs one dollar more than the ball. How much does the ball cost?
Pause the video if you want to think about it.
Most people say ten cents. But then the bat would cost one dollar ten, and the total would be one dollar twenty.
The right answer is five cents. That's the kind of trap the test is full of.
When you open the app, you're welcomed by a clean, calm start screen.
You'll get thirty-two questions and twenty-five minutes.
Harder questions are worth more points, so every answer counts.
Just type your name, press start, and the clock begins.
Each question has its own card, so you can focus on one thing at a time.
The timer stays in the corner, and turns red in the final minute.
These little bars tell you how hard the question is.
And if you get stuck, use this map to skip ahead, then come back whenever you like.
The questions get more interesting as you go, all the way to spatial puzzles like this painted cube.
Take your time on these. They're the ones that turn a good score into a great one.
Now for the exciting part. Your results appear instantly.
Your estimated IQ is shown on a gauge, from fifty-five to one hundred forty-five.
lines.tts: Your estimated I Q is shown on a gauge, from fifty-five to one hundred forty-five.

lines.say: You also see your percentile, so you know how you compare with everyone else.
Plus your classification, how many you got right, and how long you took.
Scroll down, and your score is broken down by skill area.
So you can see exactly where you shine, and where there's room to grow.

marks.label: Your answer, the right one, and why

lines.say: And here's what makes this app special: the answer review.
For every question, you see your answer, the correct one, and a short explanation.
So it's not just a score. It's practice that makes you sharper every time.

scenes.banner: Windows · Free · No installation · No Java needed

lines.say: Getting started takes just a few seconds.
Unzip the IQTest folder anywhere on your computer.
lines.tts: Unzip the I Q Test folder anywhere on your computer.

lines.say: Double-click IQTest.exe.
lines.tts: Double-click I Q Test dot E X E.

lines.say: A small window opens, and the test appears right in your browser.
There's nothing to install, and you don't need Java. It just works.

cards.title: Don't rush
cards.text: Hard questions are worth 3× the points

cards.title: Skip and return
cards.text: Use the question map when you're stuck

cards.title: Read the review
cards.text: The explanations are how you improve

lines.say: Before you begin, here are four quick tips.
Find a quiet spot, and give yourself twenty-five minutes without interruptions.
Don't rush. The hardest questions are worth three times as much.
If a question stops you, skip it, and come back with the question map.
And afterwards, read the explanations. That's where the real progress happens.

scenes.heading: Why you'll [[love it]]
items: An **answer review** that helps you improve

lines.say: So, why will you love it?
Thirty-two carefully chosen questions, across four reasoning areas.
An instant IQ estimate, with your percentile and a full breakdown.
lines.tts: An instant I Q estimate, with your percentile and a full breakdown.

lines.say: And an answer review that helps you get better every time.
Just remember, it's a fun estimate for self-assessment, not a clinical IQ test.
lines.tts: Just remember, it's a fun estimate for self-assessment, not a clinical I Q test.
